title: Rate Buydown Credits and the Builder Extended Rate Lock Locked Rate
content:
A builder rate buydown credit granted on the purchase lowers the locked rate of the Builder Extended Rate Lock.

**Rule.** The buydown share is the rate buydown credit incentives granted on the agreement as a percent of the loan amount on the lock. A buydown share of 1.0 percent or more takes 0.25 points off the rate; a buydown share above zero but below 1.0 percent takes 0.125 points off; no buydown takes nothing off. The points are percentage points of interest rate taken off the locked rate before it is held at no less than the par rate and rounded.

| Buydown share | Off the rate |
|---|---|
| none | nothing |
| above zero, below 1.0 percent | 0.125 points |
| 1.0 percent or more | 0.25 points |

The rate buydown credits are those granted on the Home Purchase Agreement ledger of the agreement the lock finances; the loan amount is the one on the lock record.

## Example (hypothetical inputs, loan amount USD 400000.00)

- Rate buydown credits granted USD 4000.00: share exactly 1.0 percent, 0.25 off.
- USD 3999.00: share just below 1.0 percent, 0.125 off.
- No rate buydown credit on the agreement: nothing off.
